output.title: Bright 1-Bedroom Apartment with South-Facing Living Room in Bonnevoie
output.description:
This 52 m² apartment offers a well-laid-out living space within the vibrant Bonnevoie neighborhood. The living room benefits from south-facing exposure, providing consistent daylight that enhances the neutral and well-maintained interior ambiance. Laminate flooring and white walls contribute to a clean and versatile living area.

The compact kitchen features a traditional galley design with white cabinetry and ceramic tile flooring, maintaining functionality and convenience despite its modest size. An adjacent bathroom, equipped with a shower-tub combination and white tiling, supports practical living requirements effectively.

Additional storage needs are addressed through a separate cellar, located within the building’s basement, enhancing the overall utility of the apartment. Positioned in Bonnevoie, the property situates residents within a lively and multicultural district, known for its diverse dining options and market, with accessibility to the central station and city center connections.
